title: Durable preparation, tutor review and approved export
goal: Let tutors clarify, revise and approve homework and post-lesson feedback across durable human pauses.
rationale: LangGraph execution continuity must preserve exact application-owned tutor decisions.
scope: Initial concise draft; specification only, no implementation or acceptance claimed. Sources: PD-18–23/26/27; Architecture sections 4/7–8/12. LangGraph with PostgreSQL checkpoints; domain records own approval. Detailed graph/API contracts are deferred. Shared review/export also supports HG-0010 feedback with its own schema; homework remains first.

depends_on.reason: Needs generated and validated homework parts for review.

requirement.title: Durable preparation, tutor review and approved export
requirement.statement: Use a small LangGraph for preparation and durable clarification/review pauses. Persist exact draft/part decisions in PostgreSQL, reject stale/duplicate effects and require valid tutor-approved retained parts for student export. Part approval alone calls no model; substantive edits regenerate and revalidate. Failed active generation requires a manual new request. Reuse these boundaries for post-lesson feedback with job-specific validation and student fields, without a homework-duration/exercise requirement; feedback approval never confirms performance observations. Across both jobs, review/approval/copying records no assignment, actual encounter, attempt or checked outcome; separate evidence intake owns those facts and revisions keep frozen history references.

scenarios.given: A draft is waiting for tutor review and its pause is durably saved.
scenarios.when: The service restarts and the tutor returns.
scenarios.then: The same draft and part decisions remain available; an actionable saved response resumes the correct graph pause.
scenarios.verification: Future process-restart and persisted review/resume observation.

scenarios.given: A tutor approves one part, then submits an outdated draft/pause action.
scenarios.then: The current part approval is saved without a model call; the stale action cannot change the current plan.
scenarios.verification: Future API/database check with recorded model-call count and stale identities.

scenarios.given: All retained parts are valid and approved for the exact draft.
scenarios.then: It creates the approved student copy without the tutor key; repeated finalization does not duplicate completion.
scenarios.verification: Future approved-export and duplicate-finalization boundary checks.

scenarios.given: An active generation fails rather than reaching a saved human pause.
scenarios.then: Failure is visible; retry creates a new request with current evidence and no carried approvals, rather than silently resuming mid-generation.

scenarios.given: A validated feedback draft has no homework duration or exercises and contains private tutor notes.
scenarios.when: The tutor approves its exact sections and requests student copy.
scenarios.then: The shared review path accepts the feedback schema, exports only valid approved student fields, excludes private notes and leaves activity-history/performance evidence and homework allowance unchanged.
scenarios.verification: Future job-typed review/export integration with synthetic canaries, row comparisons and separate accounting.

scenarios.given: An approved homework artifact is copied without a separate assignment or actual-use report.
scenarios.then: No assignment, encounter, attempt or checked-outcome fact is created; later tutor intake can record independently supported facts. Frozen request history is not silently refreshed.
scenarios.verification: Future actual review/export/intake persistence comparisons across duplicate actions.

tasks.description: Persist graph pauses and exact versioned tutor decisions with safe continuation.
Regenerate edited drafts and export only validated, approved student content.
